# `<sl-sidebar>` — Sidebar

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Sidebars hold the secondary navigation of a page. They can be collapsed to a narrow rail that shows only the group icons.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar/sidebar.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsed` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Collapses the sidebar to a narrow rail of icons. |
| `no-toggle` | `noToggle` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the collapse/expand toggle button. |
| `label` | — | `string` | `'Sidebar'` | Accessible label for the navigation landmark. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-collapse` | — | Emitted when the sidebar is collapsed with the toggle button. |
| `sl-expand` | — | Emitted when the sidebar is expanded with the toggle button. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The sidebar's content, usually `<sl-sidebar-group>` elements. |
| `header` | Optional content shown above the navigation. |
| `footer` | Optional content pinned to the bottom of the sidebar. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `header` | The header container. |
| `nav` | The `<nav>` wrapping the default slot. |
| `footer` | The footer container. |
| `toggle` | The collapse/expand button at the bottom of the sidebar. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--width` | — | The width of the expanded sidebar. |
| `--collapsed-width` | — | The width of the collapsed sidebar. |

## Documentation and examples

Compose a sidebar with [`sl-sidebar-group`](sidebar-group.md) sections containing
[`sl-sidebar-item`](sidebar-item.md) links. The button at the bottom (« when open, » when collapsed) toggles between the open and the
collapsed state; when collapsed only the group icons (and item prefix icons) remain visible.

```html
<div style="height: 720px; display: flex;">
  <sl-sidebar>
    <sl-sidebar-group label="Documenti di progetto" count="70">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="file-earmark-text"></sl-icon>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="6" current>Job Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="24">Isometric Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="6">Advance Revision Notice</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="12">Reference Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="16">Certificate and Other Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="6">Dynamic Virtual Binder</sl-sidebar-item>
    </sl-sidebar-group>

    <sl-sidebar-group label="Procurement (SAP)" count="71">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="cart"></sl-icon>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="13">Purchase Request</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="18">Purchase Order</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="7">Bid Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="23">ASO - Expediting Report</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="10">Invoice</sl-sidebar-item>
    </sl-sidebar-group>

    <sl-sidebar-group label="Comunicazione" count="47">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="send"></sl-icon>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="5">Transmittal</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="19">Correspondence</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="23">Comment</sl-sidebar-item>
    </sl-sidebar-group>
  </sl-sidebar>
</div>
```

## Examples

### Collapsed

Set the `collapsed` attribute to start in the collapsed state. Listen to `sl-collapse` / `sl-expand` to persist the
user's choice.

```html
<div style="height: 720px; display: flex;">
  <sl-sidebar collapsed>
    <sl-sidebar-group label="Documenti di progetto" count="70">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="file-earmark-text"></sl-icon>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="6" current>Job Document</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="24">Isometric Document</sl-sidebar-item>

</div>
```

### Items with icons

Items with a `prefix` icon stay visible as icons when the sidebar is collapsed.

```html
<div style="height: 260px; display: flex;">
  <sl-sidebar style="--width: 16rem;">
    <sl-sidebar-group label="Menu">
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" current><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="grid"></sl-icon>Dashboard</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#"><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="bar-chart"></sl-icon>Analysis</sl-sidebar-item>
      <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="14"><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="bell"></sl-icon>Notifications</sl-sidebar-item>
    </sl-sidebar-group>
  </sl-sidebar>
</div>
```
